Introducing FocusVision 👁️ – an AI-powered real-time concentration tracker using just your webcam!
FocusVision 👁️ is a real-time concentration tracking system that helps users monitor their mental focus using just a webcam—no wearables or invasive tools required.
The system works by analyzing facial cues in real-time using computer vision. It tracks eye openness, gaze direction, head posture, blink rate, and even yawning, then interprets these signals to compute a live concentration score.
For example:
- Frequent blinking or closed eyes may indicate fatigue
- Gaze deviation and head turns may signal distraction
- Yawning triggers a warning of low alertness
- These signals are then mapped to live alerts and scores, offering a non- intrusive, intelligent assistant that keeps you aware of your focus level.
The core challenge addressed in this project was ensuring consistent accuracy across different faces, lighting conditions, and natural movements. Through user-specific calibration and smoothing techniques, the system now adapts to each person for better performance.
FocusVision is a step toward smarter, emotionally aware computing—perfect for students, remote workers, and anyone interested in mindful productivity.
I’d love to hear your thoughts on this project!
 Any suggestions for features or use cases are welcome. Let me know what you think in the comments!

I need some help from you regarding my business.

We are operating a pickup only online grocery ordering app based in eluru (andhra pradesh, india). We pay a small commission to third-party milk stores to act as pickup points. Customers who ordered today can pickup on tomorrow evening.

Our mission is to upgrade/improve the product every product we sell or if not there should be significant price advantage. Ideally we aim to sell a much better product at the same price as market or slightly lower.

Now our plan is to open a central hub based in vijayawada, and serve all the cities/towns within a 70 km radius. 

But we are facing a dilemma.

When we start operation, we can't really open much pickup points in each city, say a city like guntur may require 50 - 60 pickup points ideally. But we realistically when kickstarting operation can open may be 5 - 6 only. 

So the products should be that good, so that users should take all the hassle of 1 day before ordering, manual pickup. As we don't have much capital, we are not also able to source several products, so these products should be very sharp.

And to daily operate a fleet of delivery vehicles to all 70 km radius, there should also be certain good order density. So the products, through very few, should be of very high frequency usage one's.

We found carbide-free safely ethylene chamber ripened bananas as one product that satisfies most of our criteria. Most banana vendors are not doing ethylene chamber ripening especially for non-robusta banana varieties, so we can feature this as a main attack advantage.

We need atleast a few more such star products to kickstart our operation. Can you please suggest? Ideally high frequency used products, ideally with a chance of improvement, and ideally with a potential chance to reduce price as well.
